# openwrt_network_interface (Resource)

A logical network interface (`config interface` in /etc/config/network).

Manages a `interface` section in `/etc/config/network`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `proto` (String) Protocol: static, dhcp, dhcpv6, pppoe, wireguard, none, ... (UCI option `proto`.)
- `section` (String) UCI section name. Changing it renames the section in place.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `ac` (String) PPPoE access concentrator. (UCI option `ac`.)
- `addresses` (List of String) WireGuard interface addresses. (UCI option `addresses`.)
- `auto` (Boolean) Bring up on boot. (UCI option `auto`.)
- `broadcast` (String) IPv4 broadcast address. (UCI option `broadcast`.)
- `clientid` (String) DHCP client identifier. (UCI option `clientid`.)
- `defaultroute` (Boolean) Install a default route from DHCP/PPP. (UCI option `defaultroute`.)
- `delegate` (Boolean) Enable prefix delegation to downstream interfaces. (UCI option `delegate`.)
- `device` (String) Underlying device, e.g. `br-lan` or `wan`. (UCI option `device`.)
- `disabled` (Boolean) Disable the interface. (UCI option `disabled`.)
- `dns` (List of String) Static DNS servers. (UCI option `dns`.)
- `dns_search` (List of String) DNS search domains. (UCI option `dns_search`.)
- `extra_lists` (Map of List of String) Additional list options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `extra_options` (Map of String) Additional scalar options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `force_link` (Boolean) Keep addresses and routes even when the link is down. (UCI option `force_link`.)
- `fwmark` (String) WireGuard firewall mark. (UCI option `fwmark`.)
- `gateway` (String) IPv4 default gateway (static). (UCI option `gateway`.)
- `hostname` (String) Hostname sent in DHCP requests (`*` = system hostname). (UCI option `hostname`.)
- `ip4table` (String) Routing table for IPv4 routes of this interface. (UCI option `ip4table`.)
- `ip6addr` (List of String) IPv6 addresses in CIDR notation. (UCI option `ip6addr`.)
- `ip6assign` (Number) Delegate a prefix of this length to the interface. (UCI option `ip6assign`.)
- `ip6class` (List of String) Allowed prefix classes for delegation. (UCI option `ip6class`.)
- `ip6gw` (String) IPv6 default gateway. (UCI option `ip6gw`.)
- `ip6hint` (String) Sub-prefix ID hint for the delegated prefix. (UCI option `ip6hint`.)
- `ip6ifaceid` (String) IPv6 interface identifier. (UCI option `ip6ifaceid`.)
- `ip6table` (String) Routing table for IPv6 routes of this interface. (UCI option `ip6table`.)
- `ipaddr` (String) IPv4 address (static). (UCI option `ipaddr`.)
- `ipv6` (Boolean) Enable IPv6 on the interface. (UCI option `ipv6`.)
- `keepalive` (String) PPP LCP echo `failures interval`. (UCI option `keepalive`.)
- `listen_port` (Number) WireGuard listen port. (UCI option `listen_port`.)
- `macaddr` (String) MAC address override. (UCI option `macaddr`.)
- `metric` (Number) Default route metric. (UCI option `metric`.)
- `mtu` (Number) MTU override. (UCI option `mtu`.)
- `netmask` (String) IPv4 netmask (static). (UCI option `netmask`.)
- `nohostroute` (Boolean) WireGuard: do not add routes to peer endpoints. (UCI option `nohostroute`.)
- `norelease` (Boolean) Do not send DHCP release on shutdown. (UCI option `norelease`.)
- `password` (String, Sensitive) PPP password. (UCI option `password`.)
- `password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only variant of `password`: never stored in state or plan. Sent when `password_wo_version` changes. Requires Terraform/OpenTofu >= 1.11.
- `password_wo_version` (Number) Bump to send a new `password_wo`. Also changes when the router's value drifts from the last one sent.
- `peerdns` (Boolean) Use DNS servers announced by the peer. (UCI option `peerdns`.)
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) WireGuard private key. (UCI option `private_key`.)
- `private_key_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only variant of `private_key`: never stored in state or plan. Sent when `private_key_wo_version` changes. Requires Terraform/OpenTofu >= 1.11.
- `private_key_wo_version` (Number) Bump to send a new `private_key_wo`. Also changes when the router's value drifts from the last one sent.
- `reqaddress` (String) DHCPv6 address request mode. (UCI option `reqaddress`.) One of: `try`, `force`, `none`.
- `reqprefix` (String) DHCPv6 requested prefix length, `auto` or `no`. (UCI option `reqprefix`.)
- `service` (String) PPPoE service name / 3G service type. (UCI option `service`.)
- `username` (String) PPP username. (UCI option `username`.)
- `vendorid` (String) DHCP vendor class. (UCI option `vendorid`.)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<config>.<section>`.
